mapper.select: SELECT id, coupon_code, user_id, template_id, coupon_value, min_consume, valid_start_time, valid_end_time, status, create_time, update_time FROM user_coupon WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, coupon_code, user_id, template_id, coupon_value, min_consume, valid_start_time, valid_end_time, status, create_time, update_time FROM user_coupon WHERE coupon_code = #{couponCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_coupon (coupon_code, user_id, template_id, coupon_value, min_consume, valid_start_time, valid_end_time, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{couponCode}, #{userId}, #{templateId}, #{couponValue}, #{minConsume}, #{validStartTime}, #{validEndTime}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_coupon SET status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE coupon_code = #{couponCode}
